en: The Malaise has really had its way with you.
Which has brought nothing but ruin on the Kingdom!
In spite of all my warnings...
Not a shred of hope is left to us.
The Malaise is still flowing through the Island...
I'll have to mess with the loop again.
Now fight. For real, this time.
“Was it you... Was it you that freed me?”
“You smell like rotting flesh... and bloodlust and a lack of respect for life...”
“But don’t think I’m just going to follow you around from now on! We could have a lot of fun together... if you remember to treat me well!”
You were a model for all of us...
What drove you to all this destruction?
You've even managed to destroy your own body...
Take this, it might be of more use to you...
I jest... You most certainly are a
Where the hell has old bones gone?
Seems like he might have been in a bit of a rush...
Do you want to resurrect from your last save?
Everything I give you is yours, PERMANENTLY. Even death won't take it from you...
SO, if you want more power... Then you better start bringing me CELLS!
You made it this far alive, eh?
Well... you know what I mean.
I work with the Collector next door.
So if you've got the Cells, I can improve your gear.
I'm the Collector, and I'm about the closest thing you’ll find to decent company around here.
Bring me the CELLS you gather from the others. In exchange, I'll procure a few useful little items for you...
Should you stumble upon a BLUEPRINT, bring it to me and I will introduce you to some more... experimental items.
Hello there! I was waiting for you.
Someone keeps leaving weird books all around the Island.
I want to try some of the... uh... stuff written there.
But I need cells, the sort you're carrying, for the experiments.
Bring me some and I will help you in exchange, would ya darling?
I know what you've been up to.
Oh yes, I know ALL your dirty little secrets.
And I've been writing them all down in my little book.
You kill things, I take notes.
I can patch up your gear for cheap...
I'm not really supposed to be here...
Let's just keep that between us, OK?
Right, c'mon then, how much have you got on you?
I could sit... just for a moment...
I think I slept a little... wait, that wasn't there before!
I've never felt anything quite like it!
Be a good sport and bring me some more... I'll send you back!
Back again? And they say dogs are man's best friend!
Thank you for bringing me more! I was really starting to get the itch there!
For the last time, my scissors are NOT made to cut hairs! Especially not those of some rotting zombie!
Blah blah blah... you never let me do anything anyway and... oh! A newcomer!
Nice to meet you, I'm the Tailor's daughter! I myself am studying to become a hairdresser... I WAS studying before all my teachers died, at least...
Yeah, let's talk about that! Who has to take care of his daughter when the school is closed, uh? The education system of this island is not what it once was...
At least, I beg you to help her work on her studies ... ask her, she might be able to comb your... green thingy.
Oh yeah! I can help you find your new style!
But I forbid you from plunging my sewing scissors in that thing!
All 3 of your stats have been increased!
You picked up a cursed artifact!
Just one little hit... And you're DEAD! Eliminate ::n:: enemies to lift the curse.
Once the curse is lifted, you’ll gain 25 extra points!
